verification_audit.method: Compared repository research coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Dragon Ball and community acquisition references.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing Final Cannon research batch was found in the repository search. Canonical identity is Super / Strike.

records.name: Final Cannon
records.character_source: Trunks (Kid) / Trunks (Future) / Gotenks customizable partner / Pan customizable partner / Tapion customizable partner / Kefla (Super Saiyan) customizable partner / Jiren customizable partner
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 52 — Super Saiyan Bargain Sale
records.skill_description: An instant rush Strike Super that charges toward the opponent and finishes with a kick that launches them upward.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference describes a short-range six-hit rush ending in a launching kick. The opponent remains airborne after the launch, allowing follow-up attacks. Exact frame data and damage percentages are not promoted to canonical fields.
records.acquisition_notes: The Xenoverse 2-specific reference identifies PQ52 as the unlock route. Independent Dragon Ball documentation likewise identifies PQ52 as the Future Warrior's random-reward route. Community reports describe the drop as RNG; no unsupported probability is recorded.
records.pve_notes: PQ52 farming is required for the documented Future Warrior route; exact drop probability and Ultimate Finish dependency remain unresolved.
records.pvp_notes: Fast short-range Strike Super with a rush sequence and launching finisher; detailed frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive.
